aboutMe.description: Md Minhazul Islam recently completed his BSc in Computer Science and Engineering at Rajshahi University of Engineering and Technology (CGPA 3.42/4.00) and currently works as a remote Research Assistant at Qatar University. His research interests center on large language models (LLMs), multimodal analysis, agentic AI, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), privacy-preserving machine learning, natural language processing, and medical text analysis. He previously worked as an AI Engineer at Makebell Ltd and as a Junior Research Scientist at GPHRF, and conducted research under the supervision of [Md. Harun Or Rashid](https://www.ruet.ac.bd/harunmr9) and [Md Azmain Yakin Srizon](https://www.ruet.ac.bd/azmainsrizon).
